title: Detailed rose
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='roseGrad' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e8354f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81430'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petalDark' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d42a45'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a0f24'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petalLight' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffa0b4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f05070'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='centerG' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd0a0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e88040'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 58 Q48 72 46 85 Q45 90 48 92' stroke='#3a9e3a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stem lighter edge -->
  <path d='M51 58 Q49 72 47 85 Q46 90 49 92' stroke='#6ad06a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaves -->
  <path d='M47 74 Q30 66 20 72 Q26 80 47 74Z' fill='#2e8a2e'/>
  <path d='M47 74 Q32 68 22 72' stroke='#5ac85a' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M47 80 Q60 74 70 82 Q62 90 47 80Z' fill='#3aa83a'/>
  <path d='M47 80 Q60 76 68 82' stroke='#5ac85a' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <!-- sepals under flower -->
  <path d='M40 58 Q34 52 28 56 Q33 60 40 58Z' fill='#4ab84a'/>
  <path d='M60 58 Q66 52 72 56 Q67 60 60 58Z' fill='#3aa83a'/>
  <path d='M50 60 Q52 54 58 55 Q55 60 50 60Z' fill='#5ac85a'/>

  <!-- outer petals -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='38' rx='16' ry='13' fill='url(#roseGrad)' transform='rotate(-30 35 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='38' rx='16' ry='13' fill='url(#roseGrad)' transform='rotate(30 65 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='26' rx='14' ry='12' fill='url(#petalLight)' transform='rotate(-50 40 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='26' rx='14' ry='12' fill='url(#petalLight)' transform='rotate(50 60 26)'/>

  <!-- mid petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='13' ry='11' fill='url(#roseGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='34' rx='11' ry='9' fill='url(#petalDark)' transform='rotate(-20 38 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='34' rx='11' ry='9' fill='url(#petalDark)' transform='rotate(20 62 34)'/>

  <!-- inner petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='10' ry='8' fill='url(#petalLight)'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='30' rx='8' ry='6' fill='url(#roseGrad)' transform='rotate(-15 44 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='30' rx='8' ry='6' fill='url(#roseGrad)' transform='rotate(15 56 30)'/>

  <!-- petal highlights -->
  <path d='M36 34 Q42 28 48 30' stroke='#ffb0c0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M64 34 Q58 28 52 30' stroke='#ffb0c0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M44 22 Q50 18 56 22' stroke='#ffb0c0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- center swirl -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='6' ry='5' fill='url(#centerG)'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='33' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#ffcc80'/>
  <path d='M50 34 Q52 31 50 29' stroke='#d06020' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#ffeedd'/>
</svg>
